description: Source code for auxiliary valve control in engine firmware, managing two digital outputs that open once per engine cycle at specific angles based on TPS input.

methods.name: turnOn
methods.description: Sets the output pin high to turn on the valve.

methods.name: turnOff
methods.description: Sets the output pin low to turn off the valve.

methods.name: auxValveTriggerCallback
methods.description: Callback function triggered by engine cycle event to schedule valve opening and closing based on engine RPM and trigger angle.

methods.name: initAuxValves
methods.description: Initializes auxiliary valves by setting up trigger event listener if valves are configured.

methods.name: updateAuxValves
methods.description: Updates valve timing based on current TPS input, interpolating start and end angles, and checks for logical consistency.
